packs.name: C418 Music Pack
packs.description:
The music that started it all.

The iconic Minecraft soundtrack returns in the C418 Music Pack, featuring nothing but the classic music from 2009-2018.

Composed by the one and only Daniel Rosenfeld (C418).

packs.name: C418+ Music Pack
packs.description:
Perfect for the ultimate C418 fan.

This pack includes all music found in the standard C418 Music Pack but expands upon it by adding unused songs from Volume Alpha/Beta so you can enjoy Minecraft even more!

Composed by the one and only Daniel Rosenfeld (C418).

packs.name: Story Mode Music Pack
packs.description:
Nothing built can last forever.

Relive the amazing songs from Minecraft Story Mode Season 1/Season 2's OST that retell the heroic story of Jesse and his best friends.

Composed by Skyler Barto & Andrew Arcadi.
